item.title: Yemen conflict with Houthis tempers oil flow news
item.description: Brent crude remains near $100 a barrel despite reports of increased Middle East oil flows, as Iran-backed Houthis fight over Red Sea shipping control.

item.title: WATCH: Finding new homes for rescued beagles
item.description: ABC News' Danny New examines Paws of War, a nonprofit that helps adopt dogs to military members, veterans, and first responders.

item.title: Trump suggests letting Iran "take out" LA, San Diego during rally
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom called President Trump "deranged and dangerous" after he suggested letting Iran "take out" Los Angeles and San Diego.

item.title: Trump suggests Iran could 'take out' Los Angeles and San Diego
item.description: President Donald Trump suggested Monday during a political rally in Nebraska that Iran could "take out" Los Angeles and San Diego, comments that drew criticism.
